'''Old Town''' was one of the main [[City/Legends|cities]] on [[Sakuub]]. It was located several days' hiking [[Time/Legends|time]] away from the [[Sky Temple of Karsol]].

Old Town contained a run-down [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], at least one [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]]-famous market, and [[Shuku's Fine Fungi]], which was located at the intersection of [[High Street]] and [[River Way]].

In [[44 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]] honeymooned there.
